checks.message: Repository provisional boundary is clearly labelled and reserved for recalculation.
All three key areas remain provisional constraints and are not described as official polygons.
Land-use polygons retain a gap-free, non-overlapping partition of the submitted provisional boundary.
Twelve handoff, waiting and honor nodes are mapped with an explicit human-priority order.
Bilingual static visual pages use local assets only and contain no scripts, remote fonts, tiles, forms or trackers.
Proposal links design judgments to sources, standards, geometry, metrics and professional follow-up.
